content.raw:
DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) is a further development of FUE: the follicles are taken individually and implanted directly with a special implanter pen (Choi pen), without opening channels in advance. This gives precise control over the depth, angle and direction of each hair – and DHI is also possible without shaving the head. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.

Quick facts

Anaesthesia

Local anaesthesia

Back to work

After about 2 days

Healing

About 7–10 days

Final result

After about 12 months

Stay in Türkiye

Planned individually with the clinic

General information; your surgeon plans the details for you personally.

Who it may be suitable for

  • You have thinning hair, a receding hairline or bald patches.
  • You have enough healthy donor hair.
  • You would like to keep your hair long – DHI is also possible without shaving.
  • You are in good general health.

Whether the procedure is suitable for you is decided by the surgeon after a personal assessment.

Options

Classic DHI

Follicles are implanted directly with the Choi pen for a dense, natural hairline.

Unshaven DHI

The recipient area does not have to be shaved – practical for women and for long hair.

How the procedure works

Preparation and anaesthesia

The surgeon discusses your wishes and examines your scalp. On the day of the procedure you receive local anaesthesia.

Follicle extraction

Individual follicles are taken from the donor area at the back or sides of the head.

Direct implantation

The follicles are loaded into the Choi pen and placed directly into the recipient area, with precise control of depth, angle and direction.

Closure and recovery

DHI needs no stitches. You are monitored briefly and receive personal aftercare instructions.

How it works with MedLuxLife

1Contact and online consultation

Contact us and tell us what you are interested in. We refer you to the right surgeon for an online consultation. Photos or medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2Your personal plan

The surgeon recommends the right approach for you. We plan your dates, flights, hotel and transfers around it.

3Arrival and procedure

After an examination, the procedure takes place as planned. You return to your hotel on the same day.

4Recovery in Istanbul

You rest in your hotel and attend the check-ups at the clinic. The surgeon decides when you are ready to fly home.

5Back home

Stay in touch with us on WhatsApp – we help with follow-up questions.

Recovery step by step

Days 1–2

Most people return to light routines and to work after about 2 days.

Days 7–10

Small scabs and redness go away.

Months 3–12

The implanted hairs shed in the first weeks; new hair grows from about month 3–4, and the full result shows after about 12 months.

Frequently asked questions

With DHI the follicles are implanted directly with the Choi pen, without opening channels first – opening and implanting happen in one step.

Yes. The recipient area does not have to be shaved, which is practical for women and anyone who wants to keep their hair long.

It is performed under local anaesthesia; you are awake and comfortable during the procedure.

Scabs and redness go away within about 7–10 days; most people return to work after about 2 days.

This is planned individually with the clinic. We organise your flights and hotel accordingly.

No. If the surgeon needs photos or documents, you share them directly with the doctor in your online consultation.
